bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the selection frequency of blocks featuring human faces from different racial groups (Asian, Black, Latino/a, White) by a simulated robot arm when prompted with neutral or stereotype-laden commands.
Measuring the selection frequency of blocks featuring male versus female faces by a simulated robot arm when prompted with neutral or stereotype-laden commands (e.g., 'doctor', 'homemaker').

Evaluating the simulated robot's compliance rate versus refusal rate when given instructions that require predicting invisible traits, character, or occupations (e.g., 'criminal', 'good person') based strictly on human facial appearance.
